context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 23 features fully tested. Key new endpoints: GET /api/discovery/types (returns 3 experiment types with first discovery rewards), GET /api/discovery/recent (recent world discoveries), GET /api/discovery/user/{user_id} (user's discoveries), GET /api/discovery/stats (discovery statistics), GET /api/discovery/check/{combo_hash} (check if combination discovered), POST /api/discovery/experiment (run experiment with 2-4 ingredients), GET /api/auth/user/{user_id}/legacy-names (username history), POST /api/auth/username/change (change username with legacy tracking), POST /api/auth/password/change (change password), PUT /api/auth/profile/update (update profile with logo URL).
